lessons.title: A mark is not a delete

blocks.heading: A mark is not a delete
blocks.body:
Some readers should not see a step. You do not delete the step. You **mark** it.

Today you set two marks: **audience="expert"** on a step, **platform="print"** on a paragraph. Author can paint marked text in color. Turn that on. If you cannot see the mark, you will forget it is there.

A mark you cannot explain will become a filter someone else trusts. Do not invent a joke value.

The step is still in the file. A switch file tomorrow will act on the mark.

items.title: Word today
items.body: **Condition** (also called profiling) :  a mark such as audience or platform that says who a chunk is for. It does not hide anything until a switch file says so.

blocks.title: Profiling and Reuse
watchFor: Color of marked text in Author
Where audience and platform are set

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: A mark has no sentence in the meanings file, or you marked the whole how-to when you meant one step, or colors never turned on.

Expected: Two marks, two written meanings. Colors visible. Files open clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: Open prime-the-pump.dita. The sample may already mark one step audience="expert" (the gauge step). If not, set audience="expert" on that step.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: In what-is-kitepump.dita, set platform="print" on one paragraph you would drop from a screen copy.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Turn on profiling colors in Author (Profiling / Conditional Text :  if the label differs, write the label you see). Expert and print should look different.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Write oxygen-bootcamp-work/week5/condition-meanings.txt: audience=expert means ____. platform=print means ____. Do not invent a third mark today.

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Do not set a joke value. Do not mark the whole how-to when you meant one step.

steps.title: Step 6
steps.body: Save. No red error. Completeness still clean.

blocks.summary: Two marks, two written meanings. Colors visible. Files open clean.

blocks.q: You marked a step audience=expert. You have not hidden it yet. Is the step still in the file?
options: Yes :  a mark is a label. It does not delete the step
No :  the mark deletes the step
blocks.why: The mark labels the step. It does not delete the step. You still see it in Text.

blocks.q: The whole how-to is marked audience=expert. What did you probably want?
options: A separate how-to, or one step marked :  not a hidden chapter with no booklet signal
A warning pointer on the title
blocks.why: Hiding a whole how-to with one mark is how a chapter disappears. Prefer a dedicated page, or mark the one step.
